fl01_takeoff_hover.note: Ground takeoff (jump) into a hover over 5th Av, climb, strafe both ways, descend to a gentle touchdown.

fl02_takeoff_to_fly.note: Fly + climb pressed on the ground: takeoff blends straight into a climbing fly line; climb released at 2.5 s levels out.

fl03_cruise_hands_off.note: Airborne over 5th Av at 60 m heading north, fly held, no look input: the fly line should hold its altitude (a player does not have to fight the camera).

fl04_boost_sonic.note: Cruise, then boost from 1.0 s to 8.0 s: one sonic boom past 120 m/s, then boost released glides back to cruise.

fl05_bank_turns.note: Cruise east over the y 640 cross street at 260 m (above the towers); stick right 2-4 s, centre, stick left 5-7.5 s: banked turns.

fl06_look_steer.note: Fly held, steering with the camera only: yaw right 45 deg/s 2-4 s, pitch up 5-6 s, pitch down 6.5-7.5 s.

fl07_climb_dive_keys.note: Fly held: climb key 2-4 s pitches the line up, descend key 5.5-7 s pitches it down, released holds.

fl08_brake.note: Cruise, then brake (E) at 3.5 s: instant stop into a hover, held in place.

fl09_dash.note: Hover over 5th Av at 30 m; dash right 1.5 s, left 3.0 s, forward 4.5 s.

fl10_slow_flight.note: Fly held with the stick pulled back: slow flight (~35 % of cruise) for precise approaches.

fl11_slam_crater.note: Hover 60 m over 5th Av, slam (F) at 1.5 s: straight dive into a superhero landing with a crater.

fl12_fast_land.note: Boost from 160 m, look down 40 deg (0.5-1.5 s): high-speed street impact = superhero landing without the slam key.

fl13_soft_land_walk.note: Hover descent from 25 m to a gentle touchdown on 5th Av, walk forward on the street, take off again.

fl14_breach_cruise.note: Cruise north up 5th Av at 35 m, turn the camera right into the east facade at > 45 m/s: through-building breach.

fl15_breach_boost.note: Boost east along the y 640 cross street at 40 m, then steer right (south) into the block at boost speed.

fl16_slow_facade_slide.note: Slow flight (stick back) straight into the 5th Av east facade at 30 m: no breach under 45 m/s, slides along the wall.

fl17_rescue_crane.note: Rescue wave 1 (seed 1977, hero at Times Square): wait for the wave, fly over to the crane load, brake, drop onto it (catch), dive down with it, set it down on the street (E), touch down.
